policy_name: Enterprise AI Procurement Governance Policy v2.4

approval_tiers.name: Standard Departmental Purchase
approval_tiers.description: Requires direct manager approval only, provided budget is available and vendor passes security.

approval_tiers.name: Department Head Sign-off
approval_tiers.description: Requires direct manager and department head sign-off.

approval_tiers.name: Executive & VP Finance Review
approval_tiers.description: High value purchase requiring VP Finance and Executive review.

duplicate_software_policy.description: Active internal software licenses with identical or overlapping capabilities must be evaluated before procuring new licenses.
